title.narrative: Civil Society Participation and engagement

description.narrative:
Strengthen democratic participation and citizen engagement, protection of human rights, including sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR), access to justice as well as delivery of equitable public services through the implementation of the Constitution and devolution.
This project is implemented in cooperation with Uraia Trust, a Kenyan non-state and non-profit organization that is focused on promoting civic engagement and civic education in the country.
